avis.titre: Manly glowing skin! Like I'm youthful again.
avis.texte: I received a sample when I purchased shaving cream. I was skeptical at first, because I am a man and wasn't sure if this would work. What sold me is the video on Clarin's site/app where I saw the guy use this in conjunction with anti aging cream. I gave it a shot and purchased the largest bottle. At first, I experienced breakouts (small bumps) on my fore head. Also, hyper pigmentation was occurring (spotty blotches on African American skin). I really wanted to call it off, meaning stop using it. But I stuck with this. After around 2 weeks, the issues stopped and I can see my skin clearing up and glowing somewhat. I use 2 full size pumps at night after washing my face with Clarin's 2 in 1 face wash/exfoliant. I don't follow up with a moisturizer as two pumps keeps my face moist enough at night. In the morning, after washing my face, I moisturize with Clarin's balm for men only and forego the serum. Hyperpigmentation occurs more when I go out in the sun after using this, so I now stick to serum as a night recovery only. So far, so good. I'll probably continue to purchase this. Price is irrelevant, I'm worth it.
